references.text: Israel fell into sin at Baal-Peor, an example of faithlessness toward the Lord that the church warns against
Reference to the faithlessness at Peor, which is the background for the accusation of 'ma'al' (faithlessness)
The command to offer sacrifices only at the place the Lord chooses, not to build their own altars
Warning against apostasy and rebellion against the Lord, with a call to act against those who lead others away from God
Achan's sin described as 'ma'al' (faithlessness) toward the Lord; the same Hebrew term is used
The continuation of the conversation where they offer the eastern tribes to move to the Lord's land rather than rebel
Reference to Achan's faithlessness ('ma'al') which brought wrath upon the entire congregation
Describes 'ma'al' (faithlessness) through intermarriage, the same concept of unfaithfulness toward God
